name: welz-publisher
description: Local-first content operations and publishing automation

scripts.build: npm run build -w @welz/shared && npm run build -w @welz/database && npm run build -w @welz/platform-core && npm run build -w @welz/automation && npm run build -w @welz/scheduler && npm run build -w @welz/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @welz/shared && npm run typecheck -w @welz/database && npm run typecheck -w @welz/platform-core && npm run typecheck -w @welz/automation && npm run typecheck -w @welz/scheduler && npm run typecheck -w @welz/desktop
scripts.test: npm run test -w @welz/database && npm run test -w @welz/platform-core
scripts.postinstall: npm run build -w @welz/shared && npm run build -w @welz/database && npm run build -w @welz/platform-core && npm run build -w @welz/automation && npm run build -w @welz/scheduler
